title: Strict Tate quotient tower evaluation identity
statement: For a Noetherian scheme T, a prime ell invertible on T, d natural, an AdicTower M for datum ell, level isomorphisms q_n from M.level n to the single complex in degree -2d of quotientLine T ell n d, and h : M.tower = strictDerivedTower T ell d, the restriction/evaluation composite after q_n inverse equals the displayed restriction/single followed by inverse evaluation/single map at every n.

source.place: Steps 2--3: strict ordinary quotient tower lift

proof.text: Exact restriction and evaluation of a single complex identify the level evaluation with the ordinary quotient projection. Substituting the strict tower equality h rewrites the final evaluation map, and functoriality of the single-complex comparison yields the displayed equation for each n.

proof_origin.place: Steps 2--3: strict ordinary quotient tower lift

lean.statement: theorem strictTateTensorTower_evaluation (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian T] (ell : ℕ) [Fact ell.Prime] (hT : IsUnit (ell : Γ(T, ⊤))) (d : ℕ) (M : AdicTower T (datum.{u} ell)) (q : ∀ n : ℕ, M.level n ≅ (_root_.DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ (-(2 * (d : ℤ)))).obj (quotientLine T ell n d)) (h : M.tower = strictDerivedTower T ell d) : ∀ n : ℕ, (pbcDerivedRestrict (pbcAdicProjection T (datum.{u} ell) n)).map (q n).inv ≫ (M.evaluation n).hom ≫ (pbcTowerEvaluation T (pbcAdicCompletion T (datum.{u} ell)) n).map (eqToHom h) = (Functor.mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor (pbcRestrict (pbcAdicProjection T (datum.{u} ell) n)) (-(2 * (d : ℤ)))).hom.app (quotientLine T ell n d) ≫ (Functor.mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor ((CategoryTheory.evaluation ℕᵒᵖ (pbcModules T (pbcAdicCompletion T (datum.{u} ell)))).obj (op n)) (-(2 * (d : ℤ)))).inv.app (strictTower T ell d)
